summary: Kept this cycle source-only (the restart/durable-vote experiment needs a custom restart-over-existing-stores harness and no Restart helper exists in the snapshot's test scaffolding, so I did not submit an unverified harness). Added the durable Behavior @k_durable_last_vote: the same-term duplicate-vote decision is read from StableStore on every RequestVote (LastVoteTerm/LastVoteCand), granting only for the identical stored candidate, with persistVote writing term then candidate before the grant is set, and restart restoring only currentTerm and the last log entry, so the last vote survives a restart. The registered investigation @q_restart_vote and its source-only interpretation (explained, no defect asserted) remain unchanged, with the discriminator ready for execution next cycle.
